description: CityGML 2.0 read then written back: one expected document compared in both geometry worlds, over a void-free lod2MultiSurface (with a hole) and lod1Solid. The emitted gml:posList must equal the source's verbatim, which is the axis-order gate - the legacy world transposes on read and back on write, the unified world stores and writes the CRS's own axis order.
